title: Reviewers saw author-year citations with no reference list

found.context: Stage D paper-mode run of the demo project: the domain seat of the review panel, round v003_1

observed_failure: The draft carries author-year citations and the bibliography is only built at P7 from references.bib, so the review packet had no reference list. The domain seat made it a major finding (DO-5) and REVIEW_AGENT scored evidence traceability down for it: a reviewer could not check what any citation pointed to.
expected_behavior: The packet builder appends a References section for the works the paper cites, from the verified registry, resolved the way GL resolves them, with no internal ids and with entries sanitized like the paper text.
lessons: What the reviewer reads must be what a reader of the finished paper would have, including the reference list.
